subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should `after_compaction` plugin hooks gain a permanent current-session-scoped deferred reset API?
rationale: This is a new public plugin capability with session-lifecycle semantics, and the previously proposed broader reset API closed unmerged; code review cannot establish permanent API direction without owner intent.

options.title: Approve the narrow hook API
options.body: Sponsor the after-compaction-only contract after the native lock gate, leaf-module refactor, parity tests, and real lifecycle proof are complete.

options.title: Keep hooks observational
options.body: Decline the reset method and require plugins to use existing session lifecycle or command surfaces outside the compaction hook.

options.title: Design a generic lifecycle API
options.body: Pause this PR and define a broader owner-approved deferred session-action contract before adding a reset-specific hook method.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow hook API
recommendation.body: Sponsor the after-compaction-only contract after the native lock gate, leaf-module refactor, parity tests, and real lifecycle proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main history signal is ownership of the plugin hook contract types and runner boundary that this PR extends.
